important_facts.fact: The Jnanpith Award is given for works in any of the 22 languages mentioned in the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution, along with English.
Rabindranath Tagore was the first Asian and Indian to win the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913 for his collection of poems, 'Gitanjali'.
G. Sankara Kurup was the first-ever winner of the Jnanpith Award in 1965 for his exceptional contribution to Malayalam literature.
